english.title: Act together with others to commit fishing offence in Tweed district
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), acting together with another or others,

(A)_[fished for or took salmon in inland waters in the Tweed district except by rod and line or net and coble]_
(B)_[fished for or took salmon in waters other than inland waters in the Tweed district except by rod and line, net and coble or bag net, fly net or other stake net]_
(C)_[fished for or took freshwater fish in inland waters in the Tweed district except by rod and line]_
(D)_[fished for or took salmon in waters in the Tweed district without legal right, or written permission from a person having such right]_
(E)_[attempted to fish for or take salmon in waters in the Tweed district without legal right, or written permission from a person having such right]_
(F)_[did an act, namely **(..SPECIFY ACT..), preparatory to the fishing for or taking of salmon in waters in the Tweed district without legal right, or written permission from a person having such right]_
english.legislation: Contrary to article 28 of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being one of two or more persons acting together
did an act
which constituted an offence against article 22 / 23 / 27 of the Scotland Act 1998 (River Tweed) Order 2006

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 3 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
